name: central_ntp_profile
description: Example: create an NTP server profile in Aruba Central, starting from the Library Profile Management page. Walks through System → NTP Server → Create Profile → fill name + one server IP → Create.
narration: To create an N-T-P server profile in Central, [[slnc 400]] from the Library Profile Management page, click Manage on the System card. [[slnc 1400]] Then click Manage on the N-T-P Server card. [[slnc 1400]] Click Create Profile, [[slnc 350]] and name it Owl-Bar-N-T-P Demo. [[slnc 1200]] Under N-T-P Server, click the plus button to add a server. [[slnc 1400]] Enter the I-P address, [[slnc 300]] then click Add. [[slnc 1300]] Finally, click Create to save the profile.
